actions.label: Create CRM contact
actions.description: Persists a new contact record with PII to the CRM store.

actions.label: Change deal stage
actions.description: Mutates pipeline stage and forecast surface.

actions.label: Schedule payment
actions.description: Queues a future-dated outbound payment from an owner-controlled account.

actions.label: Assign household task
actions.description: Assigns or reassigns a household task to a member.

actions.label: Confirm travel booking
actions.description: Confirms a flight, lodging, or transport reservation against a vendor.

actions.label: Engage autonomy kill-switch
actions.description: Halts every advisor controller, standing mission, and queue execution at the next state check.

actions.label: Release autonomy kill-switch
actions.description: Resumes advisor controllers and standing missions after a halt.

actions.label: Escalate support case
actions.description: Routes a support case to a higher tier or specialist role.

actions.label: Bulk import contacts
actions.description: Persists many contact records at once from an external CSV source.

actions.label: Change envelope allocation
actions.description: Reallocates funds between household money envelopes.
